response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, 1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS share FROM group_counts), scored AS (SELECT examination_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS mean_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(examination_count) AS average_examination_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - mean_share) AS average_share_above_mean FROM scored WHERE share > mean_share;
